title: Finding Inactive Records with LEFT JOIN and IS NULL
realWorldScenario: Growth marketing wants to run a re-engagement campaign targeting registered customers who have never placed an order.
questionStatement: Write a query using a `LEFT JOIN` between `customers` and `orders` to find all customers who have zero recorded orders. Return `customers.id`, `customers.name`, and `customers.email`, sorted by `customers.id` ascending.
starterCode:
-- Find customers with zero orders
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.name,
  c.email
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.id ASC;
hints: Join customers on the left with orders on the right.
Filter where the order ID is NULL.

testCases.description: Verify customers with no orders (all 8 customers in test seed have orders, so returns 0 rows)
